author: Judropsjj

title: A self-care app that helps you reach your goals
body:
With “journeys”/courses available to follow like ‘getting over a breakup’ or ‘boost your productivity’, this app is the most useful self-care app I’ve found as it helps you reach your specific goals by walking you through exactly how to get there. The app also has a variety of meditations, breathing exercises, check ins and also sleep visualisations so it can help you improve your wellness throughout your entire day.

A great app! My one request to the developers: can you please add in more courses? This is the best feature of the app, I think!

author: Nak1144

title: An amazing, unique meditation app ❤️
body: An absolutely amazing meditation app! I had lots of trouble going to sleep and calming my mind down, but ever since I’ve downloaded this app, I’ve been using it every night for the past couple weeks & it has helped me fall straight to sleep - I love the “sleep with a smile” one because it’s such a positive way to end the day (even when you’ve had a rough day) ☺️ I love how unique all of these meditation tracks are, because I’ve tried LOTS of other meditation apps but they were all very repetitive, so I love how Evolve has unique meditations. I also love the little details, such as the bird sounds that are constantly played in the background, it’s such a peaceful aspect and really helps me relax ✨✨
